text:
anika: Heads-up team — I'm dropping the draft RFI responses for Helix Health. Need SE + Security + Legal eyes before we hand to the buyer tomorrow EOD. Attached: helix_rfi_draft_v2.pdf, helix_capability_matrix.csv

samir: looking now. Quick Q on the POC pricing — do we propose Hosted trial credits or a Dedicated eval? buyer asked for 500 concurrent embed calls during peak test window.

anika: good catch. I put both options in the matrix (tab `poctiers`). My recommendation: Hosted with reserved burst for 1 week — cheaper and faster. If they insist on dedicated, we have a stub cost row (dedicated-monthly + setup).

jorge: For the POC checklist, we should include a small perf harness and seed dataset. Suggest plan: 3 days warmup, 4 days steady-state, 3 days spike. I'll add a `benchmark_plan.md` to the attachments. Also: infra notes for on-prem evaluation: 
```
# deploy-sanity
export REGION=eu-west-1
./run_poc --model redwood-1b-quant --batch 8 --kv-cache true
```

priya: Security review: I scanned the draft. Missing items: KMS/HSM integration details, data residency statement, retention policy for logs, and SOC2/ISO attestation links. Please fill Q24-Q30 in the `security_questionnaire.xlsx` I uploaded earlier. Also need confirmation on whether customer data will ever leave their VPC during our ingest/validation step.

anika: Priya — noted. I've answered residency and retention in the draft but will add KMS detail. For the VPC flow: we propose a customer-managed collector that writes to an S3 bucket in their account; we never stage PII in our account. I'll update language to be explicit.

legal: I can take legal review. Two asks: 1) tighten the liability paragraph in the POC T&Cs (limit to standard SLA exceptions), 2) add a data processing addendum (DPA) link. I'll prepare redlines and push back by 11:00 PT.

files-bot: Uploaded helix_rfi_draft_v2.pdf (2.1 MB), helix_capability_matrix.csv (45 KB), benchmark_plan.md (4 KB)

samir: Pricing nuance: embeddings are charged per 1k units; with their expected peak the estimate in the sheet might be ~18% higher than line-item. I've added a comment in `helix_capability_matrix.csv` on row 12 with a conservative buffer.

anika: thanks Samir — can you add a sample cost table with both conservative and optimistic forecasts? that'll help procurement.

samir: on it. I will drop a short `po_cost_breakdown.csv` and add a note about rate limits and quota bump time (2 business days for burst).

jorge: For the technical appendix, suggest we include a short curl example so their infra folks can smoke-test quickly. e.g.:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RENDER_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-medium","input":"healthcare summarization test"}'
```

priya: Also flagging: if they require HSM-backed keys on-prem, our Private offering can run with customer-managed HSM but that pushes timeline +3 weeks. Call that out in the POC constraints section.

anika: good. I'm going to do one pass and then hand to Legal and ProdSec. Tentative timeline: finalize RFI by 11:30 PT, hand to Helix by 12:00 PT.

legal: Received. I'll add the DPA stub and annotate T&Cs. If we need any non-standard terms, ping me and I'll escalate.

samir: uploaded po_cost_breakdown.csv and added conservative/optimistic columns. Also added `notes` cell recommending a pre-POC kickoff to align on dataset and masking.

anika: perfect. Final checklist before I send: SE signoff on benchmark plan, ProdSec signoff on KMS/DPA text, Legal redlines. Ping me here when done. :thumbsup:

jorge: SE signoff done. I validated the harness and included an example synthetic dataset link in the benchmark_plan.md.

priya: ProdSec signoff pending minor KMS phrasing. I'll update Q26 and confirm once uploaded.

legal: done with initial redlines — uploaded helix_rfi_legal_redlines.docx. Main change is tightening the POC liability and adding DPA reference.

anika: all done — sending to buyer now. Thanks everyone. cc @helix-ops (external) :rocket:
